name: @loopzhb/daemon
description: Loop-platform-zhb machine daemon: short-poll claim → sandboxed Claude Code runner → report, with in-process retry of unconfirmed reports. The production runner is the real Claude Code adapter (fail-closed OS sandbox, probe-pinned binary — ADR-006); the Fake Runner survives only as a test fixture. Production dependency surface is @loopzhb/protocol only; HTTP is Node 22 native fetch.
